# Vendryx

> High-performance commerce operations platform engineered for independent merchants, ecommerce builders, and modern digital brands.

## Overview

Vendryx is an end-to-end commerce infrastructure system developed by Syed Systems. It unifies branded storefronts, dynamic catalogs, real-time inventory management, guest checkout, social conversation order handoffs (WhatsApp/Instagram/Messenger), courier dispatch, and staff operations into a single memory-safe core.

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://vendryx.com/): Overview of Vendryx commerce platform, value pillars, merchant stories, and pricing.
- [Interactive Sandbox Demo](https://vendryx.com/demo): Full browser-based simulation featuring the executive dashboard, 1-click social order converter, catalog editor, order queue, and live customer checkout.
- [Merchant Account Provisioning](https://vendryx.com/signup): 14-day full access free trial registration with zero platform fees.
- [Merchant Login](https://vendryx.com/login): Secure merchant workspace authentication and dashboard access.
- [Privacy Notice](https://vendryx.com/privacy): Clear documentation of data handling, guest checkout confidentiality, and security boundaries.
- [Terms of Service](https://vendryx.com/terms): Service terms, merchant ownership rights, and uptime commitments.

## Key Capabilities

- **Guest Checkout Architecture**: Frictionless buyer checkout without mandatory account creation, reducing cart abandonment.
- **1-Click Social Order Handoff**: Converts customer chats from WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram into confirmed draft orders.
- **Zero Platform Tax**: Fixed transparent subscription plans without percentage-based revenue cuts on merchant GMV.
- **Rust Starved Primitives**: Exact decimal arithmetic without floating-point errors, preventing double-charges and currency mismatch.
- **Schema Isolation**: Dedicated Postgres schemas per domain module (Product, Cart, Order, Pricing) preventing lateral schema contamination.
- **Multi-Currency Engine**: Native support for BDT (৳), USD ($), and EUR (€) with real-time conversion.

## Pricing

- **Free Tier**: ৳0/mo — Up to 100 active products, 3 staff seats (Owner + 2), guest checkout, WhatsApp order handoff, 30-day analytics window, standard support.
- **Pro Tier**: $20/mo, 1-month minimum, 10% discount at 12+ months — Unlimited products, merchant-owned domain mapping, payment gateways, courier dispatch, full analytics history, 10 staff seats.

## Key Facts

- **Developer**: Syed Systems (Syed Monsur Construction Technology & ideas Ltd.)
- **Headquarters**: Dhaka, Bangladesh
- **Target Market**: South Asia & Global Independent Merchants, DTC Brands, and Commerce Builders
- **Architecture**: Rust backend engine, isolated Postgres schemas, Headless REST API, TypeScript storefront contract
